name: A Collection of Masks
description:
I tried on a pair of sunglasses,
so fresh,
velociraptus,
so different and unique,
who I was staring in the mirror looked ingaging.
They were light, 
had no frames, 
the lenses were prisms.
Illusion of control
over what you think is.
Not knowing it only seems.

The fact is that none of the masks I've worn ever fitted me.
